questions: What is a machine?
If the machine runs forever, does that mean it is broken?
What is complexity?
If the complexity doubles, does it take twice as long?
What is an oracle?
If the oracle gives a wrong answer, does it remain an oracle?
What is a certificate?
If the certificate looks convincing, does it settle the question?
What is a transition?
Can a transition happen without changing the state?
What is a halt?
If a halt has not happened yet, can you tell whether it ever will?
What is a reduction?
If a reduction makes something smaller, is it easier to solve?
What is a deadlock?
If a deadlock forms, will it clear by itself?
What is a stack?
If a stack gets too high, does it fall over?
What is a token?
If a token is spent, can it be used again?
What is a recognizer?
If a recognizer does not recognize something, has it rejected it?
What is a grammar?
If a grammar is ambiguous, does that mean the language is ambiguous?
What is a sentence?
If a sentence gets longer, does it become more severe?
What is a language?
If a language has infinitely many sentences, does it take infinitely long to decide whether one belongs?
What is a tree?
If a tree loses its root, do the remaining branches still form one tree?
